subject: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com>, procurement@betacloud.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud

Hi Sarah / Procurement team,

Quick summary: BetaCloud's current renewal is coming up 30 days out. Based on your usage patterns over the last 12 months we've prepared a renewal proposal that includes a 2x capacity uplift (steady-state throughput increase), a 24-month term (migrating from the current 12-month arrangement), and a commit ladder that phases capacity additions across the first three quarters to smooth billing and procurement approvals.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm preferred payment term (Net-30 / Net-45)
- Confirm vendor onboarding refresh path (portal vs. emailed vendor form)
- Approver list for PO (single sign-off or two-step approval)

Attached: BetaCloud_SOW_v2.pdf (updated rates & commit ladder), Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (placeholder onboarding steps).

Next steps I suggest:
1) If procurement prefers portal upload, we'll send vendor ID and doc links to your portal admin.
2) If you need countersigned SOW + PO, we'll route via DocuSign and share the HubSpot deal record for tracking.

Would love to get your timeline for approvals this week so we can lock preferred pricing and capacity reservations.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
[Attachment: BetaCloud_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@betacloud.com
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud

Thanks Aditya — quick note from procurement side. We like the phased commit ladder but need: 1) updated pricing table broken out by quarter and effective dates, 2) SOC2 / security evidence for vendor re-onboarding (latest report), and 3) confirmation of whether vendor onboarding will require new W-9 and vendor master update.

Our payment team prefers Net-45 for enterprise renewals; I'll confirm final approver names once I speak to Finance. We can accept a DocuSign route if you include an explicit PO attachment so the approvers can sign in sequence.

Can you send the quarter-level pricing and the SOC2 evidence?

—Sarah
Sarah Miller
Procurement Manager, BetaCloud Inc.
sarah@betacloud.com
[This message received by Aditya at 11:03 AM PDT]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud

Hi Sarah — looping in Finance / Ops. We can accommodate Net-45, and we'll prepare a revised invoice template that includes the commit ladder and milestone billing dates.

For the vendor onboarding refresh: please indicate if you prefer us to re-submit the vendor onboarding form to your portal or send a signed PDF for your vendor master team. I'm attaching our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for your review — if your portal requires field-level data we can export as CSV.

I'll also include a SOC2 summary pack in a follow-up email (we keep the full report behind an access control link for audit reviewers).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com>, procurement@betacloud.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud

Thanks Sarah — forwarding answers inline and attaching a short pricing table.

On Wed, May 16, 2028 at 11:03 AM Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com> wrote:
> Can you send the quarter-level pricing and the SOC2 evidence?

- Quarter-level pricing: see attached (BetaCloud_SOW_v2.pdf, appendix B) — pricing reflects a 10% discount on incremental capacity for first 12 months, then standard rate thereafter.
- SOC2 evidence: we host the SOC2 Type II summary pack behind an access-controlled link. Here is the auditor access tokenized link: https://procure.redwood.ai/soc2/ACCESS-BC. If you need the full report for your auditor we can route via secure share or SFTP.

DocuSign: we have prepared a sign-ready SOW + PO bundle and uploaded it to DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC12345. HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2028-0427-BC. Procurement portal vendor id (for portal upload): VID-8872.

If procurement can provide the approver sequence (name + email) and target sign date (we recommend end of next week to guarantee reserved capacity), we'll get DocuSign routing set.

Thanks,
Aditya
[Attachment: BetaCloud_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Sarah Miller <sarah@betacloud.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@betacloud.com>, procurement@betacloud.com
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: commit ladder & onboarding refresh for BetaCloud

Aditya / Laura — thanks for the speed here. We've reviewed the SOW and the pricing appendix. A few final items:
- Procurement will run the portal upload (we'll use VID-8872).
- Approver path: Tom Reed (VP Ops) will be primary approver, then Finance for final sign-off (we'll provide the finance approver email Monday).
- Payment term: Approved as Net-45, but final PO needs to state Net-45 explicitly.
- Change request: Tom asked if we can shift 10% of the initial uplift from Q1 into Q2 (to balance cloud spend). If possible please indicate the revised quarterly quantities in the final SOW.

Attached is our PO draft for countersign (BetaCloud_PO_draft.pdf). Once we have the DocuSign envelope with PO included we'll route for signatures. Ideally we sign by next Friday 24 May to lock the pricing.

Thanks — Sarah
[Attachment: BetaCloud_PO_draft.pdf (PDF, 80KB)]
